utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Lake Forest' by name among the cities in its service area.

value.name: Southern California Edison (SCE)
value.notes: Orange County Power Authority (OCPA), the only CCA operating in Orange County, directly re-verified this session via its own homepage's 'Celebrating our member communities' listing as serving exactly four member cities: Buena Park, Fullerton, Irvine, and Fountain Valley. Lake Forest is not among them, so Southern California Edison (SCE) is recorded as both the distribution and generation utility.

county.notes: Lake Forest is a well-documented Orange County city; also listed under Orange County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of Lake Forest Community Development Department, Building Division
permit_authority.notes: lakeforestca.gov returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch on every attempt this session. This department name is confirmed via search-engine indexing of the city's own page title, but the SolarAPP+ page's specific content (eligibility, fees, timeline) could not be independently verified.

permit_url.notes: URL identified via search-engine indexing; lakeforestca.gov returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch on every attempt this session, so its content could not be independently read or verified.

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Lake Forest/Orange County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

required_documents.notes: lakeforestca.gov returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch on every attempt this session, blocking access to any solar-specific submittal requirements.

eligibility_constraints.notes: Search-engine synthesis indicates the city launched an automated SolarAPP+ platform for eligible residential roof-mounted retrofit PV systems effective September 25, 2023, but this could not be independently confirmed via direct fetch this session.
